rules.description: National transposition status of the EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970

value.law: Töölepingu seaduse muutmise seadus (Employment Contracts Act amendments adopted by the Riigikogu 17 June 2026)

source.title: EUR-Lex: national transposition measures communicated for Directive (EU) 2023/970

versions.notes: EUR-Lex lists 18 Estonian measures incl. Employment Contracts Act amendments of 2026-07-03. Ministry of Economic Affairs (mkm.ee — not on the validator allow-list) states the amendments partially transpose the Directive and enter into force 13 July 2026: pay information to applicants before interview, ban on asking pay history, ban on preventing pay disclosure. Pay structures, average-pay information right, gap reporting and joint pay assessments are not transposed and not in legislative procedure.
